words.word: as all other and cut off

occurrences.text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
words: as all other and cut off

occurrences.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
